reviewItem.question: For "Removed the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label from pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether the environment has custom setups that depend on reading the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label from Strimzi pods or Services

proposed.statement: The statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label has been removed from Strimzi-managed pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services; custom setups depending on this label should use strimzi.io/pod-name instead.
